name: 60061 · Vernon Hills, IL
findings: ZIP 60061 (Vernon Hills) has 86 nonprofit organizations. 43 of them (50%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 32 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (14% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 60061 (Vernon Hills) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 60061 (Vernon Hills) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 70% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 46 organizations here; 33% of all organizations here have no identified type.
